entities.summary: Urban II, a notable figure in the history of Holy See, associated with Papal States & Investiture Controversy (1095–1198). Preceded by Crusades & the Papal Monarchy and First Crusade. Their legacy influenced Concordat of Worms resolves the Investiture Controversy and Fourth Lateran Council – pinnacle of medieval papal authority.
